短期记忆存这次会话的上下文，长期记忆跨会话记住用户的偏好和关键事实: Short-term memory keeps the context of the current session; long-term memory remembers user preferences and key facts across sessions

性能和容量分开计费，比 gp2 便宜: Performance and capacity are billed separately, cheaper than gp2

目标组挂在 EC2 Auto Scaling 组上：健康检查发现坏实例，Auto: The target group is attached to an EC2 Auto Scaling group: when a health check finds a bad instance, Auto Scaling replaces it automatically; when traffic rises, it adds machines based on requests per target
定期探测后端是否健康，不健康的不再分流量: Probes backends regularly and stops sending traffic to unhealthy ones
主站挂了自动把域名切到备用站: Automatically switches the domain to a standby site when the primary site goes down
把用户导到延迟最低的 Region: Routes users to the Region with the lowest latency
推送镜像时扫一遍已知漏洞: Scans for known vulnerabilities when an image is pushed
用 Inspector 持续扫描镜像里的系统包和语言包: Uses Inspector to continuously scan OS packages and language packages in images
镜像自动复制到别的 Region，就近拉取: Automatically replicates images to other Regions so they are pulled from nearby
同一命名空间里的 ECS 服务互相发现，代理自动做负载均衡、重试和异常检测；只管: ECS services in the same namespace discover each other, and the proxy handles load balancing, retries, and outlier detection automatically; it only covers calls between services, and external APIs don't go through this proxy

按 CPU 或请求数自动加减任务: Adds and removes tasks automatically by CPU or request count
工作节点分散到多个 AZ: Worker nodes are spread across multiple AZs
按需快速拉起最合适的节点: Quickly launches the most suitable nodes on demand
节点交给亚马逊云科技管理：自动打补丁，最长 21 天换一批新节点，节点不开 SS: Amazon Web Services manages the nodes: automatic patching, a fresh batch of nodes at least every 21 days, no SSH on nodes; vulnerabilities in the image still need ECR enhanced scanning
申请更高的并发上限，流量大也不被限流: Requests a higher concurrency limit, so heavy traffic isn't throttled
提前准备好执行环境，消除冷启动: Prepares execution environments in advance to eliminate cold starts
用容器镜像打包函数（最大 10 GB），配上 Lambda Web Adapte: Packages the function as a container image (up to 10 GB) and adds the Lambda Web Adapter; web frameworks such as Express, Flask, and Spring Boot run with almost no code changes; no always-on servers, and you pay per request
按阶段和 API 密钥限制请求速率，突发请求不会全压到后端；官方说明这是尽力而为: Limits request rates by stage and API key so bursts don't all hit the backend; officially this is best-effort, and DDoS protection needs WAF
用 Cognito 用户池、Lambda 授权方或 IAM 校验调用方：没登录、: Validates callers with a Cognito user pool, a Lambda authorizer, or IAM: unauthenticated or unauthorized requests are blocked at the gateway and never reach the backend
把响应缓存起来，少调后端，响应更快；缓存按小时收费: Caches responses to call the backend less and respond faster; the cache is billed by the hour
流量稳定时改成预置读写容量，配 Auto Scaling 自动调整，比按需便宜: When traffic is steady, switch to provisioned read/write capacity with Auto Scaling, which is cheaper than on-demand
可以把表恢复到最近 35 天内任意一秒: Restore the table to any second within the last 35 days
多个 Region 同时读写、自动同步: Read and write in multiple Regions at the same time, synced automatically
反复处理失败的消息转到单独的队列，方便排查原因: Messages that keep failing are moved to a separate queue to make troubleshooting easier
没消息时等一会儿再返回，减少空请求，省钱: Waits a while when there are no messages before returning, reducing empty requests and saving money
CloudWatch 告警盯着队列积压和死信队列里的消息数，超过阈值就通过 SN: CloudWatch alarms watch the queue backlog and the number of messages in the dead-letter queue; past the threshold, SNS sends email, SMS, or a chat message, so someone knows right away when messages pile up
EventBridge Scheduler 按时间表开关实例：开发测试环境晚上、: EventBridge Scheduler turns instances on and off on a schedule: dev and test environments stop automatically at night and on weekends and start again before work
规则订阅 Health 事件，计划维护、实例退役一来就推到 SNS、Slack，: A rule subscribes to Health events; planned maintenance and instance retirement notices are pushed to SNS or Slack so you can act early
Scheduler 的通用目标能按时间表直接调几乎任何亚马逊云科技 API，不用: The Scheduler universal target can call almost any Amazon Web Services API on a schedule, with no extra Lambda in between
适合 5 分钟内跑完的高频短流程：按执行次数和运行时长（按内存折算）计费，不按状: Suited to high-frequency, short workflows that finish within 5 minutes: billed by number of executions and run duration (scaled by memory), not by state transitions, so it's cheaper when there are many steps that run fast
并行处理上百万个项目: Processes millions of items in parallel
在多个 Region 部署状态机（现实里没有一键开关：要自己在另一个 Regio: Deploys the state machine in multiple Regions (in reality there is no one-click switch: you deploy another copy in the other Region yourself and switch with Route 53 or in the application)
备库在另一个 AZ，主库故障自动切换: The standby is in another AZ, and the primary fails over automatically
读请求分到副本上，主库压力小: Read requests go to replicas, taking load off the primary
在另一个 Region 放一份可以随时提升为主库的副本: Keeps a replica in another Region that can be promoted to primary at any time

按负载自动加减只读副本: Adds and removes read replicas automatically based on load
跨 Region 复制，通常 1 秒内同步: Replicates across Regions, usually syncing within 1 second
主节点故障自动切到另一个 AZ 的副本: If the primary node fails, it fails over to a replica in another AZ
数据分片到多个节点，容量和吞吐都能横向扩: Data is sharded across multiple nodes, so capacity and throughput can scale out
不用自己管分片数，按流量自动扩缩（按数据流小时和数据量计费）: No need to manage the shard count; scales automatically with traffic (billed by stream hours and data volume)
每个消费者独享读取吞吐，互不抢: Each consumer gets its own read throughput and they don't compete

统一管理所有表的结构，Athena、Redshift 都能直接用: Manages the schema of all tables in one place, usable directly by Athena and Redshift
只处理新增的数据，不重复跑: Processes only new data without rerunning old data
自动检查数据是否完整、是否符合规则: Automatically checks that data is complete and follows the rules
按规则直接算出分区位置，不用查数据目录；配合分区只扫需要的数据，扫得少花得少: Computes partition locations directly from rules without looking them up in the Data Catalog; combined with partitioning, only the needed data is scanned, so less scanning costs less
同样的查询直接用上次的结果: Reuses the previous result for identical queries

集群部署在两个 AZ: The cluster is deployed across two AZs
查询多的时候自动加临时集群: Adds temporary clusters automatically when there are many queries
Aurora、RDS for MySQL、DynamoDB 里的数据近实时同步进: Data in Aurora, RDS for MySQL, and DynamoDB syncs into Redshift in near real time, with no ETL pipeline to build; the direction is into Redshift, and to share Redshift data elsewhere, use data sharing or UNLOAD to S3

不用自己挑复制实例的大小，按实际用的容量单位（DCU）自动扩缩、按用量计费: No need to pick a replication instance size; it scales automatically by the capacity units (DCU) actually used and is billed by usage
把 Oracle、SQL Server 的表结构、存储过程、函数自动转换成 Au: Automatically converts the schema, stored procedures, and functions from Oracle and SQL Server to work with Aurora PostgreSQL and MySQL, so changing database engines doesn't need manual rewriting
数据节点分布在多个 AZ，还有一个 AZ 专门备用: Data nodes are spread across multiple AZs, with one extra AZ held as standby
旧数据放到便宜的温存储: Moves old data to cheaper warm storage
把索引复制到另一个 Region 的集群: Replicates indexes to a cluster in another Region

盯 EC2、ECS、EKS 里的可疑进程、文件和网络行为（要装代理，可以自动管理: Watches suspicious processes, files, and network behavior in EC2, ECS, and EKS (needs an agent, which can be managed automatically)
没在用的 Region 也开启威胁检测，攻击者在偏僻 Region 开机器也能发: Turns on threat detection in Regions you don't use, so an attacker launching machines in an obscure Region is still detected; meets compliance requirements
持续扫描 EC2 上的软件漏洞: Continuously scans EC2 for software vulnerabilities
持续扫描容器镜像里的漏洞: Continuously scans container images for vulnerabilities
扫描 Lambda 函数代码和依赖包里的漏洞: Scans Lambda function code and dependency packages for vulnerabilities
自己控制密钥策略和权限，没有密钥权限的人拿到数据也解不开: You control the key policy and permissions; anyone without key permissions can't decrypt the data even if they get hold of it
按设定周期（90–2560 天，默认 1 年）自动更换密钥材料，满足合规要求: Automatically rotates key material on a set schedule (90–2560 days, default 1 year), meeting compliance requirements
同一把密钥在多个 Region 都能用: The same key can be used in multiple Regions
用 ACM 免费证书开 HTTPS: Enables HTTPS with a free ACM certificate

主源站挂了自动切到备用源站: Automatically switches to the backup origin if the primary origin goes down
一键启用常见攻击防护规则，满足合规要求: Turns on common attack protection rules with one click, meeting compliance requirements
单个 IP 请求太多就拦截: Blocks a single IP that sends too many requests
识别爬虫、扫描器、状态监控、搜索引擎这类机器人流量，可以只计数观察、限速或拦截；: Identifies bot traffic such as crawlers, scanners, status monitors, and search engines; you can just count it to observe, rate-limit it, or block it; with the targeted inspection level you can also challenge bots that don't identify themselves
结合健康检查更快、更准地发现攻击: Combines with health checks to detect attacks faster and more accurately

推理实例分布在多个 AZ: Inference instances are spread across multiple AZs

用 HyperPod 集群训练自己的基础模型，节点坏了自动换: Trains your own foundation model on a HyperPod cluster, with bad nodes replaced automatically

请求自动分到同一地理区域里的多个 Region，扛得住突发流量；本 Region: Requests are spread automatically across multiple Regions in the same geography, handling burst traffic; if this Region fails, calls still can't get through

指标超过阈值自动告警: Alarms automatically when a metric crosses a threshold
在一个账户里看所有账户的指标和日志: See metrics and logs of all accounts from one account

查询多、还要全文搜索的业务：写操作走关系库保证事务，查询和全文搜索走 OpenS: For query-heavy workloads that also need full-text search: writes go to a relational database to keep transactions safe, while queries and full-text search go to OpenSearch so the primary database isn't overloaded
API Gateway 接请求 → Lambda 处理：写操作进 RDS 或 A: API Gateway receives requests → Lambda processes them: writes go to RDS or Aurora (relational databases such as SQL Server and MySQL, with connections pooled through RDS Proxy) → DMS keeps syncing changes in the database to OpenSearch (CDC: RDS can't push data to OpenSearch by itself, so DMS does the syncing) → OpenSearch handles queries and full-text search, keeping load off the primary database
开发测试环境只在上班时间开着，晚上和周末自动停，能省一大半实例费: Dev and test environments run only during work hours and stop automatically at night and on weekends, which saves more than half of the instance cost
EventBridge Scheduler 按时间表触发（比如工作日 9 点开、: EventBridge Scheduler triggers on a schedule (for example, start at 9 AM and stop at 8 PM on weekdays) → Lambda calls StartInstances and StopInstances (you can also use the Scheduler universal target to call the EC2 API directly, with no Lambda) → EC2 for dev and test runs only during work hours; stopped instances aren't charged instance-hours, but EBS volumes still are
访问日志实时可搜：在 Dashboards 上随时查 5xx、慢请求和可疑 IP: Access logs are searchable in real time: check 5xx errors, slow requests, and suspicious IPs on OpenSearch Dashboards at any time
ELB 每 5 分钟把访问日志写进 S3 →（可选）新文件事件先进 EventB: ELB writes access logs to S3 every 5 minutes → (optional) the new-file event goes to EventBridge first and is then routed → Lambda parses the logs line by line → the parsed entries are written into OpenSearch, and you search 5xx errors, slow requests, and suspicious IPs in real time on OpenSearch Dashboards
交易库里的数据几秒内就能在数仓里分析，不用维护 ETL 管道，还能直接用 SQL: Data in the transactional database can be analyzed in the data warehouse within seconds, with no ETL pipeline to maintain, and you can even train prediction models with SQL
Aurora、RDS for MySQL 或 DynamoDB 里的业务数据，通: Business data in Aurora, RDS for MySQL, or DynamoDB syncs into Redshift automatically within seconds through a Zero-ETL integration, with no ETL pipeline to write → reports run directly in Redshift → with Redshift ML, one line of SQL hands the training of a prediction model (for example, which users are likely to churn) to SageMaker AI in the background
商品、订单要支持全文和模糊搜索，又不想自己写同步代码: Products and orders need full-text and fuzzy search, without writing your own sync code
DynamoDB 存商品和订单 → 通过 Zero-ETL 集成（OpenSea: DynamoDB stores products and orders → a Zero-ETL integration (OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline) syncs changes into OpenSearch automatically, so you write no sync code; Lambda takes search requests and runs full-text, fuzzy, and distance-based searches in OpenSearch (⇄) ← (optional) requests come in from API Gateway
只给登录用户用的接口：令牌在网关就验掉，后端代码不用管登录: An API only for signed-in users: the token is verified at the gateway, so backend code doesn't deal with sign-in
用户先在 Cognito 用户池登录，拿到 JWT 令牌 → 请求带着令牌打到: Users sign in to a Cognito user pool first and get a JWT token → requests carry the token to API Gateway, where a Cognito authorizer verifies it first and turns unauthenticated requests away right there (⇄) → only verified requests are passed to Lambda, which knows who the user is from the token → (optional) data is read from and written to DynamoDB or Aurora
老的 Web 应用不改代码就加上登录，比如内部管理后台: Add sign-in to an old web application without changing its code, such as an internal admin console
用户访问 ALB，监听器规则里有一步认证：没登录的先跳到 Cognito 托管登: Users visit the ALB, and a listener rule has an authentication step: users who aren't signed in are redirected to the Cognito hosted sign-in page and return to the ALB after signing in (⇄) → the ALB puts the user info in request headers and forwards to EC2 or ECS, so the old app doesn't need its own sign-in
用户上传头像、照片、视频：文件不经过自己的服务器，省带宽、扛得住并发: Users upload avatars, photos, and videos: files skip your own servers, saving bandwidth and handling high concurrency
App 先找 Cognito 身份池换一份临时凭证（权限只够写这位用户自己的目录: The app first gets temporary credentials from a Cognito identity pool (permissions only allow writing to that user's own folder), then uploads photos and videos straight to S3 with those credentials, without going through your own servers → CloudFront distributes the files from nearby
每个用户只能让智能体办自己权限内的事，比如查自己的订单、改自己的资料: Each user can only have the agent do things within their own permissions, such as checking their own orders or editing their own profile
用户先用 Cognito 登录拿到令牌 → AgentCore Runtime: Users sign in with Cognito and get a token → AgentCore Runtime accepts only requests with a valid token (inbound authentication, ⇄), and AgentCore Identity knows who is calling this time → the agent calls Lambda through Gateway to get things done, using that user's own permissions
私有文档、付费课程、会员视频：在 CDN 边缘就挡掉没登录的请求: Private documents, paid courses, member videos: requests without sign-in are blocked at the CDN edge
用户先在 Cognito 登录拿到令牌 → 每个请求到了 CloudFront: Users sign in with Cognito and get a token → each request reaching a CloudFront edge location is checked by Lambda@Edge first, and users who aren't signed in are redirected to the sign-in page (⇄) → only verified requests go back to the origin for content (optional: the origin is S3); private documents and paid videos can't be downloaded by anyone holding just the link
防止桶被误设成公开导致数据泄露，发现了几分钟内自动关掉: Prevents data leaks from a bucket accidentally set to public, and turns it off automatically within minutes of detection
S3 桶被人设成公开 → Config 托管规则（s3-bucket-publi: An S3 bucket is set to public → a Config managed rule (such as s3-bucket-public-read-prohibited) detects it right away, and auto remediation calls a Systems Manager Automation document to turn on Block Public Access for this bucket (⇄) → the compliance state change event is sent to EventBridge and forwarded to the security team (email or chat)
防止有人图方便把 SSH、RDP 端口开给整个互联网: Prevents someone from opening the SSH or RDP port to the whole internet for convenience
EC2 的安全组被人改成对 0.0.0.0/0 开 22 端口 → Config: An EC2 security group is changed to open port 22 to 0.0.0.0/0 → the Config rule restricted-ssh detects it, and auto remediation calls the Systems Manager Automation document AWS-DisablePublicAccessForSecurityGroup to delete that rule (⇄) → EventBridge notifies the security team
免疫「暴露在公网的实例被 SSH 暴力破解」：对整个互联网开着的 22 端口几分: Immune to “Internet-exposed instance hit by SSH brute force”: port 22 open to the whole internet is closed within minutes
下单、支付、发货这种跨好几个系统的流程，中间哪一步失败都能自动撤回前面的: Order, payment, and shipping span several systems; if any step fails, the earlier steps are rolled back automatically
API Gateway 接下单请求 → Step Functions 按步骤编排: API Gateway receives the order request → Step Functions orchestrates the steps: deduct inventory, charge payment, create the shipment order; if any step fails, the earlier steps are undone → each step runs on Lambda → order status is stored in DynamoDB + (optional) shipping tasks are put into SQS, and the warehouse system picks them up at its own pace
账户的安全基本盘：入口过滤、威胁检测、漏洞扫描、合规检查都有: The basics of account security: entry filtering, threat detection, vulnerability scanning, and compliance checks are all covered
（可选）WAF 挡在入口过滤恶意请求 + GuardDuty 盯着账户和网络里的: (optional) WAF filters malicious requests at the entry point + GuardDuty watches for abnormal behavior in the account and network + Inspector continuously scans EC2, container images, and Lambda for vulnerabilities + Config checks whether configurations are compliant and automatically fixes non-compliant ones + (optional) KMS manages encryption keys centrally with automatic rotation
免疫「安全审计没过」：检测、扫描、合规检查都有记录: Immune to “Failed security audit”: detection, scanning, and compliance checks are all on record
数据一变就通知下游：下单后加积分、发通知、做风控，各系统互不耦合: When data changes, downstream systems are notified: award loyalty points, send notifications, and run fraud checks after an order, with no coupling between systems
订单表一有新增、修改，DynamoDB Streams 按顺序记下每条变更（CD: Whenever the orders table gets a new item or an update, DynamoDB Streams records each change in order (CDC) → Lambda reads the change stream (you can also connect directly with EventBridge Pipes, no code needed) → EventBridge receives the business events that Lambda converted, and downstream systems such as points, notifications, and risk control each subscribe on their own
业务库的每一次改动近实时同步到数据湖、搜索或数仓，分析拿到的总是新数据: Every change in the business database is synced in near real time to the data lake, search, or data warehouse, so analytics always sees fresh data
DMS 持续抓 RDS 或 Aurora 的变更日志（CDC：MySQL 的 b: DMS continuously captures the change logs of RDS or Aurora (CDC: MySQL binlog, PostgreSQL WAL) → the changes are written to Kinesis Data Streams → Amazon Data Firehose lands them in an S3 data lake or writes them to OpenSearch for real-time search, or Redshift streaming ingestion reads straight from Kinesis, so data is queryable within seconds + (optional) DMS task status changes are sent to EventBridge, so you are alerted right away if the sync breaks
缓存和数据库总是一致：数据一改，对应的缓存马上刷新: The cache and the database always match: as soon as data changes, the matching cache entry is refreshed
DynamoDB 里的数据一改，Streams 按顺序记下变更 →（可选）用 E: When data in DynamoDB changes, Streams records the change in order → (optional) EventBridge Pipes filters and forwards it, so you don't write your own polling → Lambda deletes or refreshes the matching cache entry in ElastiCache → reads always get fresh data, with no waiting for the cache to expire
机房里的老系统上云：数据库先迁过来一直保持同步，选个时间切过去，停机只要几分钟: Move an old on-premises system to the cloud: migrate the database first and keep it in sync, then cut over at a chosen time with only a few minutes of downtime
DMS 把机房的数据库全量搬到 RDS 或 Aurora（换引擎的先用 Sche: DMS copies the on-premises database in full to RDS or Aurora (if the engine changes, use Schema Conversion first to convert table structures and stored procedures), then keeps syncing changes, so the old and new databases stay matched ← at cutover, the application switches to EC2 in the cloud and connects to the new database, with only a few minutes of downtime
处理失败的消息不会丢：先存进死信队列，修好以后再重新处理: Messages that fail processing are not lost: they are stored in a dead-letter queue first and reprocessed after the fix
EventBridge 把事件投给 Lambda → Lambda 处理失败、重: EventBridge delivers events to Lambda → events that Lambda fails to process after using up all retries are moved to an SQS dead-letter queue (DLQ) and kept safe → a CloudWatch alarm watches the message count in the dead-letter queue; after the bug is fixed, use DLQ redrive to send the messages back for reprocessing
上线前把有高危漏洞的镜像挡住，上线后新爆出的 CVE 也能马上知道: Block images with critical vulnerabilities before release, and learn about newly disclosed CVEs right away after release
镜像推进 ECR，Inspector 马上扫一遍漏洞（⇄）→ 没有高危漏洞的镜像: An image is pushed to ECR and Inspector scans it for vulnerabilities right away (⇄) → only images with no critical vulnerabilities are deployed to ECS, EKS, or EC2; once running, Inspector keeps watching and finds newly disclosed CVEs too + (optional) Inspector findings are sent to EventBridge, which automatically notifies the owner and opens a ticket
多台机器要读写同一批文件，比如 CMS 的媒体库、机器学习的训练数据: Multiple machines need to read and write the same files, such as a CMS media library or machine learning training data
ELB 把请求分到多台机器 → EC2、ECS 或 EKS 上的应用都挂同一个: ELB spreads requests across multiple machines → applications on EC2, ECS, or EKS all mount the same EFS file system → a file uploaded by a user is written once and readable from whichever machine takes the request, and adding machines needs no file syncing + (optional) VPC has an EFS mount target in the subnet of every AZ
多步骤的 AI 工作流：每一步可审计、可重试，比如合同审核、报告生成: A multi-step AI workflow where every step can be audited and retried, such as contract review or report generation
Step Functions 编排多步任务 → Lambda 调用工具和接口 →: Step Functions orchestrates the multi-step task → Lambda calls tools and APIs → Bedrock inference decides the next step
根据用户刚刚的点击实时推荐商品、内容: Recommend products and content in real time based on what the user just clicked
Kinesis 收用户的点击、浏览行为 → Lambda 读流，调 SageMa: Kinesis receives user clicks and browsing behavior → Lambda reads the stream and calls a SageMaker AI inference endpoint to compute recommendations (⇄) → the results are written to DynamoDB or ElastiCache, and the frontend reads them directly when the page opens
全球用户访问接口：边缘接入加速，恶意流量在边缘就过滤掉: Global users call the API: edge access speeds it up, and malicious traffic is filtered out at the edge
CloudFront 在边缘接住请求 + WAF 过滤恶意流量 → API Ga: CloudFront takes the request at the edge + WAF filters malicious traffic → API Gateway handles it → (optional) Lambda runs the backend logic
扛大流量 DDoS：网络层和应用层攻击都有人兜底，被打期间的扩容费用也能申请抵扣: Withstand large-scale DDoS: both network-layer and application-layer attacks are covered, and you can apply for credit on scaling costs incurred during an attack
CloudFront 分发或 ALB 加进 Shield Advanced 保护: A CloudFront distribution or ALB is added to Shield Advanced protection → to defend against application-layer attacks, associate a WAF Web ACL with this entry point and include at least one rate-based rule; the subscription includes the Anti-DDoS managed rule group, which spots an HTTP flood within seconds and blocks or challenges it → network-layer attacks are blocked directly by Shield Advanced
WAF 不交每圈的固定费用，升「托管规则」「限速规则」半价：Shield Adv: WAF has no fixed fee each lap, and the “Managed rules” and “Rate-based rules” upgrades are half price: the Shield Advanced subscription covers the standard WAF fees on protected resources (Bot Control is not included and stays at full price)
新请求全被拒绝：停一轮，或者交 $80 加急提额、继续走: All new requests are rejected: skip a turn, or pay $80 to rush a quota increase and keep going
Lambda 升了「提高并发配额」，或者 CloudWatch 开了「告警与仪表: Lambda has the “Raise concurrency quota” upgrade, or CloudWatch has “Alarms and dashboards” (alarm when quota usage is nearly full)
自动扩缩也会撞上配额；用 Service Quotas 提前申请提高，并给配额用: Auto scaling can also hit quotas; request increases ahead of time with Service Quotas and set CloudWatch alarms on quota usage
你名下没有多区域功能的服务都变成 Impaired（暂停收过路费）: All your services without a multi-Region feature become Impaired (rent is paused)
有多区域功能的服务和全局服务（Route 53、CloudFront、Shiel: Services with a multi-Region feature and global services (Route 53, CloudFront, Shield Advanced) are not affected
用 Route 53 健康检查 + 故障转移路由切到另一个 Region；切换要: Use Route 53 health checks + failover routing to switch to another Region; the switchover must complete automatically on the data plane, so don't count on changing control plane configuration during an outage; rehearse in advance
实习生误删了生产数据: Intern deleted production data by mistake
拆掉你数据库组的 1 级升级（不退钱）；没有可拆的就交 $100 进奖池: Remove one level-1 upgrade from your database group (no refund); if there is nothing to remove, pay $100 into the Jackpot
你有带备份功能的升级（S3 版本控制、DynamoDB 时间点恢复、EBS 自动: You have an upgrade with a backup feature (S3 versioning, DynamoDB point-in-time recovery, EBS automatic snapshots, EC2 automatic AMIs, EFS automatic backups); the online healthcare company is immune (not counted in Hell Mode)
删除保护只防删掉整个实例或整张表，误删数据要靠时间点恢复和备份；备份要定期演练恢: Deletion protection only prevents deleting a whole instance or table; accidentally deleted data needs point-in-time recovery and backups; rehearse restores from backup regularly
你名下没有弹性扩展功能的实例型服务变成 Impaired；要是全都扛住了（而且你: Your instance-based services without an elastic scaling feature become Impaired; if everything holds up (and you own any services), collect $100 from Amazon Web Services
持有「订单削峰」架构：直接领 $100: Holding the “Order load leveling” architecture: collect $100 directly
Auto Scaling 按负载加减实例；可预期的高峰用预测性扩缩或定时扩缩提前: Auto Scaling adds and removes instances with load; for predictable peaks, use predictive scaling or scheduled scaling to add machines in advance; queues can smooth out peaks
你每块服务按升级级别交：1 级 $25、2 级 $50、3 级 $100；每份容: For each of your services, pay by upgrade level: level 1 $25, level 2 $50, level 3 $100; plus $10 per unit of capacity, all into the Jackpot
用掉 Cost Explorer 卡（开了成本异常检测，早发现早处理）: Use Cost Explorer card (anomaly detection caught it early)
用 Budgets 设账单告警，用 Cost Anomaly Detection: Use Budgets to set billing alarms, and Cost Anomaly Detection to find abnormal spending
直接进维护窗口，不经过 Startup 扶持: Go straight to the Maintenance Window, without passing Startup Credits
别给 root 用户创建访问密钥，并给它开 MFA；亚马逊云科技会扫描公开的 G: Don't create access keys for the root user, and turn on MFA for it; Amazon Web Services scans public GitHub repositories and notifies you when it finds a leaked access key, and IAM user keys also get a quarantine policy attached automatically
有数据保护类升级：KMS「客户托管密钥」（没有密钥权限读不出来）、CloudFr: You have a data protection upgrade: KMS “Customer managed keys” (data can't be read without key permission), CloudFront “Origin access control”, Config “Auto remediation” (automatically sets it back to private); with only GuardDuty, each payment is cut in half
账户级开启 S3 Block Public Access；Config 规则 s: Turn on S3 Block Public Access at the account level; the Config rule s3-bucket-public-read-prohibited finds public buckets, and auto remediation (automation document AWS-DisableS3BucketPublicReadWrite) sets them back to private; GuardDuty only alerts
有人手动改了生产配置: Someone manually changed the production configuration
后退 3 格，结算落点: Move back 3 squares and resolve the square you land on
用 CloudFormation 或 CDK 管理基础设施，用 Config 或: Manage infrastructure with CloudFormation or CDK, and use Config or CloudFormation drift detection to find manual changes
依赖的第三方 API 挂了: A third-party API you depend on is down
停一轮，或者交 $80 临时切到备用供应商、继续走: Skip a round, or pay $80 to switch to a backup supplier and keep moving
持有 SQS 或 Step Functions（排队 + 重试）: Holding SQS or Step Functions (queuing + retries)
调用外部 API 要设超时，重试加指数退避和随机抖动；处理不了的消息转进 SQS: Set timeouts on external API calls, and retry with exponential backoff and jitter; move messages you can't process to an SQS dead-letter queue, and put them back in the original queue for reprocessing after the other side recovers
二选一：交 $100 进奖池紧急换证书；或者让你的 ELB 或 CloudFro: Choose one: pay $100 into the Jackpot to replace the certificate urgently; or make your ELB or CloudFront (the one with higher rent if you have both) Impaired, pausing its rent until it recovers automatically at the start of your next turn. If you have neither (or both are already Impaired), you can only pay
你的 ELB 或 CloudFront 升到了 HTTPS（ACM 自动续期）: Your ELB or CloudFront has the HTTPS upgrade (ACM auto-renews)
用在 ELB、CloudFront 上的 ACM 公有证书免费，用 DNS 验证: ACM public certificates used on ELB and CloudFront are free, and DNS validation lets them renew automatically
你名下最贵的实例型服务如果还是单 AZ（EBS 卷永远算单 AZ）：变成 Imp: If your most expensive instance-based service is still single-AZ (EBS volumes always count as single-AZ): it becomes Impaired, and you pay 10% of its price into the Jackpot for emergency recovery
最贵的那块已经升了多 AZ；ECS 本来就跨 AZ 分散任务。只在单 AZ 的: Your most expensive one already has the Multi-AZ upgrade; ECS already spreads tasks across AZs. Putting an ELB in front of EC2 in a single AZ doesn't count
生产环境至少跨两个 AZ；ELB 和 Auto Scaling 组都要配多个 A: In production, span at least two AZs; both ELB and Auto Scaling groups need subnets in multiple AZs
凌晨 3 点被告警叫醒: Woken by an alarm at 3 a.m.
现场讲一次你（或者你同事）半夜被告警叫醒的经历：讲出来了，领 $50 加班费、照: Tell the group about a time you (or a colleague) were woken by an alarm in the middle of the night: if you do, collect $50 overtime pay and carry on as usual; if you can't, skip a turn, or pay $80 for an on-call colleague to handle it
你的 CloudWatch（万能服务）绑在了含 Lambda 或 EC2 的架构: Your CloudWatch (wildcard service) is attached to an architecture that includes Lambda or EC2, and that Lambda or EC2 is yours and online: the alarm calls Lambda directly, or restarts or recovers the EC2 (not counted as a penalty)
告警要配好运行手册（Runbook），能自动处理的用 Systems Manag: Set up a runbook for alarms, and handle what can be automated with Systems Manager automation documents or Lambda
付 $100 给 CloudWatch 的主人；没人买就进奖池；主人是你自己就免: Pay $100 to the owner of CloudWatch; if nobody owns it, it goes into the Jackpot; if you are the owner, you pay nothing
日志的钱主要花在摄取上：控制日志级别、用低频访问日志类；保留期只省存储那部分: Most log cost comes from ingestion: control log levels and use the infrequent access log class; retention only saves the storage part
CloudFormation 栈创建失败，整栈回滚: CloudFormation stack creation failed, whole stack rolled back
已经建好的资源全删掉、从头再来：退回 Startup 扶持，这次不算经过起点，不: All resources already created are deleted and you start over: return to Startup Credits, this does not count as passing Go, so you collect no Credits and pay no running cost
栈创建失败默认整栈回滚：已经建好的资源全删掉，栈停在 ROLLBACK_COMP: By default, a failed stack creation rolls back the whole stack: all resources already created are deleted, and the stack stays in ROLLBACK_COMPLETE and can only be deleted and recreated; when troubleshooting, you can turn off rollback on failure to keep the resources that were created successfully, fix the template, and continue deploying
其他玩家当审计员，每人问你一个安全问题（比如根用户开 MFA 了吗、S3 桶是公: The other players act as auditors and each asks you one security question (for example, is MFA on for the root user, is the S3 bucket public); if more than half think you answered well enough, you pass. If you fail: skip a turn to remediate, or pay $80 to rush the remediation
持有「安全防护基线」架构，或者 2 块以上安全组服务，或者有审计类升级（WAF: Holding the “Security baseline” architecture, or 2 or more security-group services, or an audit-type upgrade (“Managed rules” on WAF or Config, CloudTrail “Log file integrity validation”, KMS “Automatic rotation”, and so on); the financial compliance company is immune
用 Security Hub CSPM 持续检查安全标准和合规: Use Security Hub CSPM to continuously check security standards and compliance
你名下还是单 AZ 的实例型服务（IaaS、PaaS、EKS；EBS 卷永远是单: Your instance-based services that are still single-AZ (IaaS, PaaS, EKS; EBS volumes are always single-AZ) become Impaired
大多数托管服务和全局服务本来就跨多个 AZ，不受影响；EC2 这类实例型服务要升: Most managed services and global services already span multiple AZs and are not affected; instance-based services like EC2 survive only with the Multi-AZ upgrade, and an ELB in front is not enough
多 AZ 部署让一个 AZ 出问题时服务照常运行；可以用 FIS 的「AZ 断电: A Multi-AZ deployment keeps the service running when one AZ has a problem; you can rehearse in advance with the FIS “AZ power interruption” scenario
