对象存储：文件当成「对象」放进桶里，按存的数据量和请求次数收费，容量不用提前规划: Object storage: files are stored as “objects” in buckets and billed by the amount of data stored and the number of requests, with no capacity planning. The Standard storage class stores data across at least 3 AZs in one Region.
网站图片和静态资源、数据湖、备份归档、日志: Website images and static assets, data lakes, backup and archive, logs
托管的共享文件系统（NFS）：多台 EC2、容器、Lambda 能同时挂载同一个: Managed shared file system (NFS): multiple EC2 instances, containers and Lambda functions can mount the same directory at once; capacity grows as you write and you pay for what you use.
多台服务器共用的文件、内容管理、机器学习训练数据: Files shared across many servers, content management, machine learning training data
给你的 App 和网站管用户登录：用户池存账号，负责注册、登录、MFA，登录后发: User sign-in for your apps and websites: a user pool stores accounts and handles sign-up, sign-in and MFA, and issues JWT tokens after sign-in; an identity pool exchanges a signed-in user's identity for temporary Amazon Web Services credentials so the app can access services such as S3 directly. Billed by monthly active users (MAU).
App 和网站的注册登录、给 API 加登录校验（API Gateway、ALB: Sign-up and sign-in for apps and websites, adding sign-in checks to APIs (API Gateway and ALB both accept Cognito tokens directly), mobile apps uploading files straight to S3
Bedrock AgentCore：把 AI 智能体推上生产的托管平台。Runt: Bedrock AgentCore: a managed platform for taking AI agents to production. Runtime hosts and runs agents (frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI and Strands all work), each session runs in its own microVM, and you are billed for the compute actually used; components such as Memory, Gateway, Identity and Observability can be combined as needed.
客服助手、运维助手、能调业务接口的 AI 助理: Customer service assistants, operations assistants, AI assistants that can call business APIs
云上的虚拟服务器：自己选 CPU、内存和操作系统，按秒计费，可以用按需、Savi: Virtual servers in the cloud: you pick CPU, memory and operating system, billed by the second, and you can buy them On-Demand, with Savings Plans, as Spot and more. Each instance lives in one AZ, so for high availability you place several in multiple AZs, together with ELB and Auto Scaling.
跑各种应用、需要完全控制操作系统的场景: Running all kinds of applications, cases that need full control of the operating system
给 EC2 用的块存储（云硬盘）：一块卷挂在同一个 AZ 的实例上当系统盘或数据: Block storage for EC2 (cloud disks): a volume attaches to an instance in the same AZ as a system or data disk, and snapshots can be taken as backups. A volume lives in a single AZ.
系统盘、自建数据库的数据盘: System disks, data disks for self-managed databases
你在云上的私有网络：自己划网段、子网、路由表和安全组，决定哪些资源能访问公网。V: Your private network in the cloud: you define the CIDR range, subnets, route tables and security groups, and decide which resources can reach the internet. The VPC itself is free.
把对外的负载均衡放公有子网，应用和数据库放私有子网: Put the public-facing load balancer in a public subnet, and the application and database in private subnets
负载均衡：把流量分给后面多台 EC2、容器或 Lambda，自动绕开不健康的；A: Load balancing: spreads traffic across multiple EC2 instances, containers or Lambda functions behind it and automatically routes around unhealthy ones; ALB handles HTTP/HTTPS and NLB handles TCP/UDP.
网站和 API 的统一入口、多 AZ 高可用: A single entry point for websites and APIs, Multi-AZ high availability
托管的 DNS：注册和解析域名，能按健康检查做故障切换，按延迟或地理位置把用户引: Managed DNS: registers and resolves domain names, can fail over based on health checks, and routes users to different Regions by latency or geolocation. A global service with a 100% availability SLA.
域名解析、跨区域容灾切换: Domain name resolution, cross-Region disaster recovery failover
托管的容器镜像仓库：存放 Docker / OCI 镜像，可以扫描漏洞，ECS、: Managed container image registry: stores Docker and OCI images and can scan for vulnerabilities; ECS and EKS pull images directly from it.
CI/CD 构建完镜像推上去，部署时拉下来: Push images here after a CI/CD build, and pull them at deployment
亚马逊云科技自己的容器编排服务：告诉它要跑几个任务，它负责调度、替换坏掉的；底层: Amazon Web Services' own container orchestration service: tell it how many tasks to run and it schedules them and replaces failed ones; the underlying compute can be EC2 or Fargate (no servers to manage).
托管的 Kubernetes：控制平面由亚马逊云科技在多个 AZ 里运行，每个集: Managed Kubernetes: Amazon Web Services runs the control plane across multiple AZs and each cluster is billed by the hour; worker nodes can use EC2, managed node groups, Fargate or Auto Mode.
已经在用 Kubernetes 的团队上云、多环境统一部署: Teams already using Kubernetes moving to the cloud, unified deployment across environments
无服务器函数：上传代码，有事件来才运行，按请求次数和运行时长（毫秒）收费，没请求: Serverless functions: upload code and it runs only when an event arrives, billed by number of requests and run time (in milliseconds), with no charge when there are no requests; a single run can last up to 15 minutes.
API 后端、处理 S3 上传的文件、定时任务: API backends, processing files uploaded to S3, scheduled tasks
托管的 API 入口：创建 REST、HTTP、WebSocket API，负责: Managed API front door: create REST, HTTP and WebSocket APIs, with authorization, throttling and caching, connected to Lambda or other services behind it and billed by number of calls.
Serverless API、移动应用和小程序后端: Serverless APIs, backends for mobile and web apps
Serverless 的键值和文档数据库：毫秒级读写，按需模式按请求收费，数据自: Serverless key-value and document database: millisecond reads and writes, on-demand mode billed per request, data automatically stored across multiple AZs; global tables allow reads and writes in multiple Regions at once.
用户会话、购物车、游戏数据、高并发场景: User sessions, shopping carts, game data, high-concurrency workloads
托管的消息队列：生产者把消息放进队列，消费者按自己的速度取。标准队列至少送达一次: Managed message queue: producers put messages in the queue and consumers take them at their own pace. Standard queues deliver at least once; FIFO queues guarantee order.
订单削峰填谷、把系统拆开互不拖累、异步任务: Smoothing order spikes, decoupling systems so they don't drag each other down, asynchronous tasks
Serverless 事件总线：把亚马逊云科技服务、自己的应用和 SaaS 发出: Serverless event bus: routes events from Amazon Web Services services, your own applications and SaaS to Lambda, Step Functions and others by rule, and can also trigger on a schedule.
事件驱动架构、跨账户分发事件、定时任务: Event-driven architectures, distributing events across accounts, scheduled tasks
可视化的工作流编排：把 Lambda、容器任务和各种服务的 API 调用串成状态: Visual workflow orchestration: chains Lambda, container tasks and API calls to many services into a state machine, with built-in retries, branching and parallelism, and can pause to wait for human approval.
订单处理流程、数据处理流水线、编排 AI Agent 的步骤: Order processing flows, data processing pipelines, orchestrating the steps of AI agents
托管的关系数据库：支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、MariaDB、Ora: Managed relational database: supports MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Oracle, SQL Server and Db2, and handles backups, patching and failover for you. A Multi-AZ deployment keeps a standby instance in another AZ.
传统业务系统、电商订单库: Traditional business systems, e-commerce order databases
亚马逊云科技自研的云原生关系数据库，兼容 MySQL 和 PostgreSQL：: Amazon Web Services' own cloud-native relational database, compatible with MySQL and PostgreSQL: data is stored as 6 copies across 3 AZs, with up to 15 read replicas; Aurora Serverless v2 scales automatically with load, and Global Database can span Regions.
托管的内存缓存：Valkey、Redis OSS、Memcached，读写在微秒: Managed in-memory cache: Valkey, Redis OSS and Memcached, with reads and writes in microseconds to milliseconds, placed in front of the database to absorb hot reads.
实时数据流：Kinesis Data Streams 接住每秒大量的事件，多个程: Real-time data streaming: Kinesis Data Streams absorbs large numbers of events per second and lets multiple applications read at once; Data Firehose can deliver data straight into S3, Redshift and OpenSearch.
点击流和日志实时分析、实时大屏、IoT 数据: Real-time analysis of clickstreams and logs, live dashboards, IoT data
Serverless 的数据集成（ETL）服务：爬取数据源建数据目录，用 Spa: Serverless data integration (ETL) service: crawls data sources to build a data catalog, cleans and transforms data with Spark jobs, and is billed by run time.
数据湖入湖、给 Athena 和 Redshift 准备数据: Loading a data lake, preparing data for Athena and Redshift
Serverless 交互式查询：直接用 SQL 查 S3 里的数据，不用建集群: Serverless interactive query: query data in S3 directly with SQL, with no cluster to build, billed by the amount of data scanned. Storing data in columnar formats and partitioning by date means far less is scanned, which saves money.
日志分析、数据湖临时查询: Log analysis, ad hoc data lake queries
云数据仓库：列式存储、大规模并行处理，用 SQL 分析海量数据；有预置集群和 R: Cloud data warehouse: columnar storage and massively parallel processing, analyzing huge amounts of data with SQL; available as provisioned clusters or Redshift Serverless.
数据库迁移服务：把机房或别的云上的数据库搬到亚马逊云科技，同构（MySQL 到: Database migration service: moves databases from your data center or another cloud to Amazon Web Services, either homogeneous (MySQL to RDS for MySQL) or heterogeneous (Oracle to Aurora PostgreSQL). After the full load it keeps capturing changes on the source database (CDC), so old and new stay in sync and cutover downtime is short. Billed by the hour for replication instances; DMS Serverless is billed by usage.
数据库上云、把业务库的改动实时同步到数据湖、搜索或数仓（CDC）: Moving databases to the cloud; syncing changes from your business database to a data lake, search, or data warehouse in real time (CDC)
托管的 OpenSearch（从 Elasticsearch 分出来的开源项目）: Managed OpenSearch (the open-source project forked from Elasticsearch): full-text search, log analytics and visualization, and it can also serve as a vector database.
站内搜索、日志检索、RAG 的向量检索: Site search, log search, vector search for RAG
威胁检测：持续分析 CloudTrail 事件、VPC 流日志和 DNS 日志等: Threat detection: continuously analyzes CloudTrail events, VPC Flow Logs, DNS logs and more to find crypto mining, leaked credentials, and unusual access. It only detects and does not block, so pair it with EventBridge and Lambda for automated response.
账户安全监控、自动响应安全事件: Account security monitoring, automated response to security events
自动漏洞扫描：持续扫描 EC2、ECR 里的容器镜像和 Lambda 函数，找出: Automated vulnerability scanning: continuously scans EC2 instances, container images in ECR, and Lambda functions for software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure, and scores them by risk.
托管的密钥管理：创建和管理加密密钥，S3、EBS、RDS 等服务用它加密数据，密: Managed key management: create and manage encryption keys that S3, EBS, RDS and other services use to encrypt data. Keys never leave KMS in plaintext, and every use is logged in CloudTrail.
静态数据加密、控制谁能解密数据: Encrypting data at rest, controlling who can decrypt data
CDN：把网站、视频和 API 缓存到全球各地的边缘站点，用户就近访问，减轻源站: CDN: caches your website, video and APIs at edge locations around the world so users connect to the nearest one, which takes load off the origin. Comes with Shield Standard against common DDoS attacks.
网站和静态资源加速、视频分发: Speeding up websites and static assets, video delivery
Web 应用防火墙：挂在 CloudFront、ALB、API Gateway: Web application firewall: sits in front of CloudFront, ALB, or API Gateway and blocks SQL injection, cross-site scripting, and malicious bots by rule. It can also rate-limit by IP.
防常见 Web 攻击、防刷接口: Defending against common web attacks, preventing API abuse
DDoS 防护：所有账户都免费带 Shield Standard，挡常见的网络层: DDoS protection: Shield Standard is included free on every account and blocks common network-layer attacks. Shield Advanced is a paid subscription that adds application-layer protection, Shield Response Team (SRT) support, and credits for scaling costs during an attack.
对 DDoS 敏感的大型网站、游戏、金融业务: Large websites, games, and financial workloads that are sensitive to DDoS
机器学习平台：在上面准备数据、训练、调参和部署模型，有托管的 Notebook: Machine learning platform: prepare data, train, tune, and deploy models in one place. Includes managed notebook environments, and inference endpoints are billed by instance hours.
训练自己的模型、部署推理服务: Training your own models, deploying inference services
用 API 调用多家公司的基础模型（Anthropic Claude、Amazo: Call foundation models from multiple companies (Anthropic Claude, Amazon Nova, Meta Llama, Mistral, and more) through an API, billed per input and output token. Also includes Knowledge Bases, Agents, and Guardrails. Your data is not used to train models.
监控和可观测性：收集指标、日志和事件，设告警、做仪表板，告警可以通知人，也能触发: Monitoring and observability: collects metrics, logs, and events, sets alarms, and builds dashboards. Alarms can notify people or trigger Auto Scaling.
盯 CPU、错误率和延迟，出事自动告警: Watching CPU, error rate, and latency, and alerting automatically when something breaks
配置记录和合规检查：持续记录账户里每个资源的配置和变更历史，用规则检查合不合规（: Configuration recording and compliance checks: continuously records the configuration and change history of every resource in your account, and checks compliance with rules (for example, whether an S3 bucket is public or an EBS volume is encrypted). Noncompliant resources can be remediated automatically.
合规审计、查清楚是谁把配置改坏了、自动把公开的 S3 桶改回私有: Compliance auditing, finding out who broke a configuration, automatically making a public S3 bucket private again
记录账户里的 API 调用：谁在什么时间、从哪里、做了什么操作。控制台默认能查最: Records API calls in your account: who did what, when, and from where. The console shows the last 90 days of management events by default; create a trail to store them in S3 long term.
安全审计、查清楚是谁删了资源: Security auditing, finding out who deleted a resource

EC2、RDS、Aurora 这类实例型服务买下时只在一个可用区（AZ），那个: Instance-based services such as EC2, RDS, and Aurora sit in a single Availability Zone (AZ) when you buy them, and fail if that AZ has a problem. Upgrade to the level with Multi-AZ to survive an AZ outage (RDS and Aurora: Level 1 “Multi-AZ”; EC2: Level 2 “cross-AZ Auto Scaling”). EBS is always single-AZ. 格子上的「2 AZ」小框、玩家面板服务图标的级数: The “2 AZ” tag on a square, and the level number on service icons in the player panel
升了跨区域复制、全局表这类功能，扛得住整个 Region 出问题（比如「us-e: With features such as cross-Region replication and global tables, it survives a whole Region going down (for example the “us-east-1 widespread outage” card). Each one counts 2 points toward the Reliability pillar.
被 Health 事件打挂了：这段时间不收过路费，服务还在你手上，运行费照交。: Knocked out by a Health Event: no rent is collected for now, but you still own the service and still pay the running cost.
到主人的下一个回合开始时自动恢复；Spot 被抢走、破产分给债主、主人把它下线时: Recovers automatically at the start of the owner's next turn; cleared immediately if a Spot service is taken, it goes to a creditor in bankruptcy, or the owner takes it offline
暂时停机，相当于抵押。只有 EC2、RDS、Aurora、Redshift、EC: Temporarily shut down, like putting it up as collateral. Only EC2, RDS, Aurora, Redshift, and ECS can go offline: you get half the purchase price back to stay afloat. While offline it collects no rent and doesn't count as owned (not for a color group, an architecture, or a pillar), and the running cost drops to a storage fee only ($5 per lap for EC2, RDS, Aurora, and Redshift; none for ECS).
至少下线 3 轮，之后主人在资产管理里还那一半再加原价 10% 重新上线；下线期: Offline for at least 3 rounds; after that the owner pays back the half plus 10% of the original price in Assets to bring it back online. While it is offline, anyone who lands on it can pay the full price to take it for themselves
被对手用 DDoS 打下线：不收过路费、不算持有，运行费照交。: Knocked offline by an opponent's DDoS: no rent, doesn't count as owned, and you still pay the running cost.
到发动的人第 2 个回合开始时恢复；有 Shield Advanced 或 Cl: Recovers at the start of the attacker's 2nd turn; it can't be hit if it has Shield Advanced or CloudFront
用自己出的低价买下的空闲容量（只有 EC2、ECS、EKS、SageMaker: Spare capacity bought with your own low bid (only EC2, ECS, EKS, and SageMaker AI): it can't be upgraded and you can't add capacity.
别人落上来比你多出原价的 10% 就能抢走（抢的人不付这次过路费，你拿回出价的一: Anyone who lands on it can take it by paying 10% of the original price more than you did (they don't pay the rent this time, and you get half of your bid back); in Assets you can pay the difference to convert it to On-Demand, after which nobody can take it
服务图标角上的数字是升到第几级；「+1」「+2」是加了几个容量（实例、分片、节点: The number on the corner of a service icon is the level it has been upgraded to; “+1” and “+2” are how many capacity units have been added (instances, shards, nodes…), and each capacity unit adds 25% to the rent.
升级只能落在自己的服务上做；容量落地时或者在资产管理里随时能加；资产管理里能去掉: Upgrades can only be made when you land on a service you own; capacity can be added when you land, or any time in Assets; in Assets you can remove an upgrade or capacity for a half refund

用掉一张就划掉一个: Cross one off each time you use one

我曾经是个爱玩的孩子。儿时和小伙伴围在一起玩经典地产类桌游：大家去买地、收租金，: I was once a kid who loved to play. As a child I would gather with friends around a classic property-trading board game: everyone bought land, collected rent, and at the end the player with the most assets won. It was simple and lively, and I never forgot it.
后来在亚马逊云科技的生态里，我也玩过不少有趣的作品，比如 BuildCards，: Later, in the Amazon Web Services ecosystem, I played quite a few fun projects too, BuildCards for one, but afterwards I always felt something was missing: as cloud professionals, we need deeper gameplay, and better, more complex rules.
二十年后的某个夜晚，我忽然有了这样的灵感：参考一部分经典地产类桌游的规则，再做一: One night twenty years later, an idea came to me: borrow some of those classic property-trading rules, extend them, and share what I know about Amazon Web Services and cloud architecture through a game, so people can pick up cloud architecture easily while they play, and make it a game of our own, for our community. That is how Cloud Tycoon came about.
云上大亨借鉴了经典地产类桌游的那份轻松；我又用自己所学的知识和积累，加进了云服务: Cloud Tycoon borrows that easygoing feel, and using what I have learned and the experience I have built up, I added the real things of the cloud: services, architectures, bills and outages, along with plenty of technical upgrades and new ideas, so it is more than just a game: it is a place to learn while we play. In the game, you can quickly learn what each cloud service can and can’t do and how it is typically used, and you can also combine services into Amazon Web Services architectures that collect combined rent. If you’d like to pair it with BuildCards, you can also use BuildCards cards to lay out the architecture your services form.
也许在每一次和小伙伴的交锋中，在缅怀童年玩乐的同时，我们就不知不觉掌握了使用亚马: In every match against friends, while reliving childhood fun, we may pick up the skills to use Amazon Web Services without even noticing.
一路走来，要感谢 UG 的各位小伙伴帮忙测试、做美工设计和修 bug：很多个夜晚: Along the way, thanks go to everyone in the User Group for testing, art and design, and bug fixes. On many nights, Chongchong tested the game’s features online with me, found bugs, suggested features, and took on part of the art work; Latiao submitted a whole pile of bug-fix PRs; Damo set up a server in China to cut access latency; and Yuki made lots of suggestions for improvements early in development. Without your help, this game could never have reached everyone so quickly.
希望 User Group 能帮助更多的小伙伴快速上手亚马逊云科技，也希望你在这: I hope the User Group helps many more people get started with Amazon Web Services quickly, and I hope that here you can find again the joy of gathering around the dice with friends as a kid. My skills are limited and there are bound to be rough edges, so please bear with me.
